patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Linear and monday.com share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Linear only if your buying job matches “Modern issue tracker for product/engineering teams — Free limited; Basic from ~$8/user/mo ” rather than monday.com's shape. Choose monday.com only if your buying job matches “Work OS / work management platform with boards, timelines, automations and AI credits — Ba” rather than Linear's shape. Workflow advantage: Linear leans shared coverage; monday.com leans team-collaboration-work, resource-planning. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Linear and monday.com share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Linear is Modern issue tracker for product/engineering teams — Free limited; Basic from ~$8/user/mo annual.; monday.com is Work OS / work management platform with boards, timelines, automations and AI credits — Basic from $9/seat/mo annual (3-seat minimum)..
- Company-size focus: Linear (startup, small-business, mid-market) vs monday.com (small-business, mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Linear-leaning — vs monday.com-leaning team-collaboration-work, resource-planning.
- Researched limits: Linear — Not for company-wide marketing/ops Work OS; monday.com — Paid plans enforce a 3-seat minimum — solo/micro teams pay for unused seats.

Limitations — Linear: Not for company-wide marketing/ops Work OS; Leaner automation than Jira Enterprise; monday.com: Paid plans enforce a 3-seat minimum — solo/micro teams pay for unused seats; AI credits are bundled/paid extras that raise effective TCO beyond the seat floor.

Poor-fit cases: Linear is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not for company-wide marketing/ops Work OS · monday.com is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Paid plans enforce a 3-seat minimum — solo/micro teams pay for unused seats · Avoid Linear if you actually need monday.com's motion (Work OS / work management platform with boards, timelines, automations and AI cr)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
